title: Living Wiki chunk
description: Schema for deterministic text chunks derived from source derivatives.

chunk_ref.description: chk: prefix followed by first 32 hex of sha256(source_version + ':' + start + ':' + end)

source_ref.description: Identifier of the source record, derivative, or capture

source_version.description: sha256 hex of the normalized derivative text

text_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the exact un-normalized chunk text slice

heading_path.description: Hierarchical heading context leading to this chunk

text.description: Optional verbatim chunk text slice corresponding to span
